A.question: Are official reuse rights of Congreso data and separate legal basis for purpose-specific person ranking demonstrably equivalent?
A.estimand: Documented general reuse conditions vs a concrete case-specific legal basis for identifiable personal fantasy-score treatment

B.H1: General notice and data-access rules establish a definitive person-level ranking license
B.H0: General reuse conditions exist, but not a definitive user-specific GDPR basis or safety clearance for scoring
B.other: Particular datasets may have additional use-specific exclusions or conditions

C.falsifier: Exact legal wording authorizes use case and suffices with a documented independent processing basis
negative_controls: Do not infer consent from public availability
Do not conflate website reuse notice with personal-data lawful basis
Do not infer real scoring from machine-readable JSON XML availability

retrieved_sources.title: Aviso legal Congreso
retrieved_sources.evidence: Reutilization subject to preserving meaning, content, citation, update and lawful use

retrieved_sources.title: Ley 37/2007 consolidated BOE
retrieved_sources.evidence: Article 3(4) personal data and Article 8 reuse conditions in applicable scope

retrieved_sources.title: AEPD legal bases
retrieved_sources.evidence: Lawful basis must be documented for processing

retrieved_sources.title: AEPD search engines/original publisher purposes
retrieved_sources.evidence: Original vs secondary processing may have distinct legal justifications

D.method: Official first-party web source indexed text, no processing of real nominal files, not legal opinion

F.adversarial: The general site text may allow some reuse, but does not authenticate a legal basis for any particular processing of identifiable people. It would be wrong to assert either universal prohibition or automatic commercial profiling permission. Ley 37/2007 scope and special circumstances of parliamentary institutions need qualified legal review; consolidated BOE text is not an official binding opinion.

H.update: General reusable conditions established documentary; purpose-specific identifiable ranking remains unresolved.

I.product: Actionable rights gate matrix and acceptance evidence checklist
I.science: No empirical political novelty or strong identity research validation

J.decision: ACCEPT_SOURCE_REUSE_NOTICE_EVIDENCE, KEEP_NAMED_SCORE_BLOCKED, STOP_R5 repeating same legal notices until legal counsel or purpose-specific dataset rights arrive
